chunks: Thus We tried some of them through others, so that they might say, 'Are these the ones of us upon whom God has bestowed favour?' Is not God All-Knowing of the grateful?
ai.seo_question: Why does God test people through one another according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse elucidates the wisdom of social stratification and varying degrees of provision as a means of distinguishing the truly grateful (ash-shakirun) from the ungrateful. It challenges the human tendency to attribute divine favor to specific lineages or individuals, affirming that Allah’s knowledge encompasses the inner sincerity of all servants. This concept reinforces the Shia emphasis on spiritual merit over mere social status, as seen in the selection of the Imams.
